subject: planner: seperate methods in `PlanContext` and `EvalContext`/`BuildContext` (#51382)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (64d824acd8) focusing on planner/executor/session. Change is a refactor: `PlanContext` no longer embeds `expression/context.BuildContext`; instead callers obtain an expression build/eval context via `PlanContext.GetExprCtx()` and pass it to expression APIs (e.g., equality checks, constant eval, predicate pushdown, explain formatting). Session wiring updated to keep a dedicated expr context (`GetExprCtx()`), while `PlanContext` retains planning-only methods. In inspected hot paths (planner selectivity/predicate pushdown/ranger building; executor merge join compare), updates are mechanical context-parameter replacements with no observed semantic logic changes. No Blocker/High issues found.
